description_html: The Wacom One replacement pen is designed for use with the Wacom One creative pen display (DTC133). The pen is cordless and battery-free with 4,096 levels of pressure. It also boasts a programmable side-switch to give you quick and easy access to shortcuts for a smoother work-flow.
